These chat templates are copies of files in the TRL library, version 1.14.1,
directory trl/chat_templates (https://github.com/huggingface/trl). The Apache
License 2.0 applies to TRL. TRL keeps these files as copies of the chat
templates of the model families that their names give. The files are not
changed. Their SHA-256 values are the values in the RECORD file of the TRL
1.14.1 wheel:

gemma.jinja   ecd6ae513fe103f0eb62e8ab5bfa8d0fe45c1074fa398b089c93a7e70c15cfd6
llama3.jinja  ba03a121d097859c7b5b9cd03af99aafe95275210d2876f642ad9929a150f122
phi3.jinja    dcaee66df77bfbb789ec541fe713218da30225a526f1db97138fc39ee6dc56aa
qwen3.jinja   a55ee1b1660128b7098723e0abcd92caa0788061051c62d51cbe87d9cf1974d8

The structural template check must pass each file. The tests check the
exact review list of each file.
